owner_note: Queue new art and make it very realistic and alien. Not just a yak please. Strange! It lives on the night side.
prompt: RimWorld sprite of the ossrith, a nocturnal grazer of the Cauldron's night side, in side view facing right. Anatomy: a lean, long-legged frame under bone-white overlapping plate, a bare mask of bone for a face with deep black sockets and no visible mouth line, and a jagged ridge of hard green crystal breaking up through the plates along its spine, thickest at the shoulders. Make it genuinely alien and strange, a creature that evolved on another world: unfamiliar body plan and joint arrangement, asymmetric crystal growth, long digitigrade legs that bend in unexpected places, an elongated skull, hide plates that look like fossilised shell. The silhouette reads as a different animal from any hooved grazer, with no horns, no mane, no shaggy coat and no bovine proportions. Lit by cold night light, with the crystal faintly translucent green.
style_notes: Realistic painted natural-history illustration of an alien animal: grounded, believable anatomy and weight, matte bone texture, soft painted edges, silhouette carried by value and colour contrast; strange and eerie rather than cute or cartoonish.
